canonical_project: Galaxy Backbone Kano Tier IV Data Centre
notes: Tier IV (Uptime Institute professional/TCCF certified) national data centre on Ahmadu Bello Way, Kano; launched Sept 2022, one of two Tier IV facilities in Nigeria, ~2.2PB storage, DR/business-continuity for Galaxy Backbone Abuja. First Nigeria facility with Uptime Tier IV certification.
